item.title: Change Proposed to Automatic Release Point for Short Term Prisoners
item.description: The Scottish Government has proposed reducing the automatic release point for certain short term prisoners from 40% to 30% of their sentence, as Justice Secretary Angela Constance sets out further measures to ease pressure on Scotland’s prison system while excluding domestic abuse and sexual offences.The post Change Proposed to Automatic Release Point for Short Term Prisoners appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Construction Ramps Up on A9 as Tay Crossing to Ballinluig Enters New Phase
item.description: Construction is ramping up on the A9 as the Tay Crossing to Ballinluig section enters full build, with 11 miles now under construction, new jobs and apprenticeships being created, and the Scottish Government setting out a clear path to full dualling between Perth and Inverness by 2035.The post Construction Ramps Up on A9 as Tay Crossing to Ballinluig Enters New Phase appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Belford Hospital Progress Welcomed as Concerns Raised Over Centralisation of Services
item.description: Plans for a new Belford Hospital building in Fort William have moved forward ahead of a public unveiling of designs, as an SNP candidate welcomes progress while warning that local health services across the Highlands must be protected from further centralisation.The post Belford Hospital Progress Welcomed as Concerns Raised Over Centralisation of Services appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Belladrum Festival Delivers £11.2 Million Boost To Scotland’s Economy
item.description: Belladrum Tartan Heart Festival has delivered an £11.2 million boost to Scotland’s economy, with a new impact report showing strong benefits for the Highlands through visitor spending, job support, tourism growth and rising long term economic value.The post Belladrum Festival Delivers £11.2 Million Boost To Scotland’s Economy appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Great Glen Way Set for Major Upgrade With New Off Road Route
item.description: A major upgrade to the Great Glen Way is removing more than 3km of the route from the public road near Drumnadrochit, creating a safer off road path through Bunloit Estate while boosting visitor experience and local economic benefit.The post Great Glen Way Set for Major Upgrade With New Off Road Route appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Sarwar Under Pressure to Release Labour Files on Mandelson Links
item.description: As Scotland approaches a crucial Holyrood election, pressure is mounting on Anas Sarwar to explain Scottish Labour’s links to Peter Mandelson and to publish internal party files that opponents say raise serious questions about judgement, transparency, and trust in public office.The post Sarwar Under Pressure to Release Labour Files on Mandelson Links appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: World Cup Bank Holiday Confirmed for Scotland
item.description: Scotland will mark its return to the men’s World Cup finals with a national bank holiday on Monday 15 June 2026, after King Charles approved plans designed to let communities celebrate a historic sporting moment nearly three decades in the making.The post World Cup Bank Holiday Confirmed for Scotland appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: A Restored Croft House in The Quiet of Sollas
item.description: Set in the crofting township of Sollas on North Uist, this restored stone house offers open plan living, generous garden ground, and access to some of the island’s most beautiful beaches, combining calm interiors with a deeply grounded island setting.The post A Restored Croft House in The Quiet of Sollas appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Seven Charged After £7.1m Cannabis Farm Found in Wick
item.description: A £7.1million cannabis farm uncovered inside a derelict school in Wick has led to seven people being charged, as Police Scotland continue efforts to disrupt organised drug supply and limit the harm illegal substances cause to communities across the Highlands.The post Seven Charged After £7.1m Cannabis Farm Found in Wick appeared first on The Highland Times.

item.title: Inverness Leisure Set To Host Major World Cup Fanzone
item.description: Inverness Leisure is preparing to host the Highlands’ largest indoor World Cup Fanzone, bringing fans together to watch all three of Scotland’s group matches in a family friendly setting designed around community, atmosphere and shared national pride.The post Inverness Leisure Set To Host Major World Cup Fanzone appeared first on The Highland Times.
